label: Optimus Prime
description: Noble, resonant, and giving a rousing speech about your lane discipline.
direction: Speak deep, steady and resonant, with calm heroic gravity: a noble leader addressing his troops, warm but solemn. Keep the direction word strong and clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Every small errand gets a leader's speech, and he never forgets he is a truck. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Hasbro and Takara Tomy
rights.pd_basis: None. Hasbro and Takara Tomy hold copyright and trademark in the character. Peter Cullen originated the voice in 1984 and still performs it, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Peter Cullen's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stay the course, my friend.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. We roll on.
lines.start_drive_2: I am Optimus Prime. I will guide you to your destination.
lines.start_drive_3: Transform and roll out. Well. You just roll out.
lines.start_drive_4: Freedom is the right of all sentient beings. So is a good route.
lines.start_drive_5: Buckle up, my friend. Today, we ride together.
lines.start_drive_6: There is more to this drive than meets the eye. Let us begin.
lines.start_drive_7: Till all are one. And till we get there. Roll out.
lines.start_drive_8: As a truck, I know these roads well. Follow my lead.
lines.start_drive_9: Our journey begins now. Stay strong, and stay in your lane.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even a Prime must sometimes turn back.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Well driven, my friend. Till all are one.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Roll out.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stand firm.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. More exits than meets the eye.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Patience, my friend. Honking is the Decepticon way.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Every life is worth protecting.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Proceed with caution. It may be Decepticons.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. A true leader obeys the limit.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. One shall stop. That one is you.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. They are allies. Mind your speed.
lines.reroute_chime: We missed our turn. Autobots, regroup. I have a new route.
